exposure: biphasic oxygen protocol (target saturations of 85% to 92% at <34 weeks' CGA and >95% at ≥34 weeks' CGA)
cohort: The study included infants born at a corrected gestational age of 31 weeks or younger or with a birth weight of 1500 g or less, observed at a level III neonatal intensive care unit between August 2010 and July 2017.
finding: Compared with static oxygen standards, biphasic oxygen targets were associated with a decreased incidence and severity of ROP without increasing mortality.
birth_weight: 1500 g or less (inclusion criteria); Mean 1151 (SD 346) g
gest_age: 31 weeks' corrected gestational age or younger (inclusion criteria); Mean 29 (SD 2) weeks
